query:
DELETE t1 FROM investments t1
INNER JOIN investments t2 
WHERE t1.id > t2.id
  AND t1.company_name = t2.company_name
  AND t1.announcement_date = t2.announcement_date
  AND t1.target_country_name = t2.target_country_name
  AND COALESCE(t1.target_name, '') = COALESCE(t2.target_name, '')
  AND t1.deal_size_usd = t2.deal_size_usd;
